name: The Crack Connection
notes: Won a disqualification-marred tag rematch against the Mischief Makers on Monday Night Distress after Bobby Borden struck Tully Rascal with a chair.
caption: A tag team who won a chair-marred disqualification rematch against the Mischief Makers on Monday Night Distress.

name: The Mischief Makers
notes: Won a first meeting against the Crack Connection by disqualification, then lost the chair-marred rematch on Monday Night Distress.
caption: A tag team disqualified in a chair-marred rematch against the Crack Connection on Monday Night Distress after having beaten them by disqualification two weeks earlier.
